messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the person's identity to match the person in the reference photo. Use the reference photo for facial identity, and make the body's skin tone consistent with the target person. Keep the current hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, scene, and camera unchanged.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please change the person's identity to match the person in the reference photo. Use the reference photo for facial identity, and make the body's skin tone consistent with the target person. Keep the current hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, scene, and camera unchanged.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character stands facing forward, blinks, and then slowly turns her head to her left (viewer's right) into profile.","camera":"A static, medium close-up shot from the chest up, centered on the character.","clothing":"A bright red, off-the-shoulder sleeveless top.","hair_color":"Light brown with pinkish highlights from the ambient lighting.","hairstyle":"Light brown hair with straight bangs and two low buns or pigtails at the sides of the head.","identity":"A 3D-rendered female character with dark skin, a small nose stud, and a neutral expression.","scene":"A futuristic, neon-lit environment at night, featuring a large glass dome structure with pink framing and glowing cyan circular light rings in the background."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The character's face and body became much darker, with the face appearing nearly black in shadow and only the lips, eyes, and highlights visible. The original light skin tone was replaced by a dark skin tone, and the facial features appear altered toward a darker-skinned identity. The hairstyle, red top, futuristic scene, and camera framing remain broadly the same.
arguments.requested_change: Change the person's facial identity to match the reference photo and make the body's skin tone consistent with the target, while preserving hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, scene, and camera.
uncertain: Whether the new facial identity specifically matches the reference person cannot be confidently judged because the output face is mostly in shadow.
unexpected_changes: The face is excessively darkened and underexposed, making facial identity details hard to see.
The character's expression and facial visibility changed noticeably due to the dark lighting.
